headline: Anthropic reports Claude-authored machine-checked proofs across OSS-Fuzz RISC-V binaries
summary: Anthropic reports that Claude produced Rocq-checked proofs for 239 OSS-Fuzz entry points across 123 libraries. The public Theorem repository currently lists a smaller subset: 60 entry points in 25 libraries. Its public theorems compare plain and sanitizer builds under an LPS Linux-process model, for specified process inputs and memory budgets; they concern code reachable from each entry point, do not prove termination, and do not exclude sanitizer-undetected errors such as wrong results or memory leaks. The model is explicitly incomplete. The difference between Anthropic’s reported scope and the current public subset remains unresolved; no independent sample check was performed.
